one_line: A village gavunda from Gangavadi-96000, mediating land, taxes and temple grants under the Western Ganga kings.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, used to field work and travel between villages
appearance.face: oval face with a gently square jaw, medium-brown Dravidian complexion, straight nose, thick brows, a neatly trimmed short moustache, faint sun lines around the eyes, default expression calm and observant with a hint of wary responsibility
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled back into a compact low knot at the back of the head, front kept smooth with no fringe, wrapped with a narrow dull-gold cloth band; a simple off-white cotton turban cloth is loosely looped once around the head and tied at the back, leaving the knot visible
appearance.costume: A knee-length off-white handloom cotton angavastra-style upper wrap, worn diagonally over the left shoulder and across the chest, paired with a finely pleated, ankle-length dark indigo cotton dhoti (veshti) wrapped tightly and tucked in front; under the wrap he wears a plain, close-fitting, creamy-beige cotton tunic with elbow-length sleeves for modesty; around his waist a broad reddish-brown woven cloth belt holds a small cloth pouch; he wears a simple iron torque-style neck ornament, a single slim copper bangle on the right wrist, and leather sandals; on his left shoulder he carries a rolled palm-leaf bundle tied with string, and his overall textiles are slightly worn but clean, with very subtle thin white stripes on the dhoti border and a darker indigo edge at the hem.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved iron-tipped bamboo staff about his own height, banded with two dull-bronze rings near the top and bottom, carried in his right hand as both walking staff and symbol of his authority when inspecting fields, tanks and temple lands.

ref_desc: A medium-brown, oval-faced mid-30s gavunda with a short moustache, black hair in a low knot under a loose off-white turban, wearing an off-white upper wrap over a beige tunic and dark indigo dhoti with reddish-brown belt, simple ornaments and sandals, carrying a bronze-banded bamboo staff.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Western Ganga–era gavunda from Gangavadi: a medium-brown, oval-faced man in his mid-30s with a short moustache and calm, observant expression, thick black hair pulled into a compact low knot at the back of his head, a narrow dull-gold cloth band around the knot, and a simple off-white cotton turban cloth looped once around his head and tied at the back so the knot is visible; he wears a modest, close-fitting creamy-beige cotton tunic with elbow-length sleeves, covered by a knee-length off-white cotton upper wrap draped diagonally over his left shoulder and across his chest, paired with an ankle-length dark indigo pleated dhoti with a slightly darker indigo border at the hem, all in slightly worn but clean handloom textures; a broad reddish-brown woven cloth belt around his waist holds a small cloth pouch, and he has a plain iron torque-style neck ornament, a single slim copper bangle on his right wrist, and simple leather sandals; on his left shoulder rests a rolled palm-leaf bundle tied with string, and in his right hand he carries his signature long, slightly curved bamboo staff with iron tip and two dull-bronze rings near the top and bottom; show him from front, side and back to clarify the fixed hairstyle, draped garments, belt and staff, using a restrained palette of off-white, dark indigo, reddish-brown, dull gold and medium-brown skin, in a dignified, grounded historical look with shonen-anime energy but strictly realistic clothing and accessories.
